hookLine: Let's rank the craziest UFC moments ever! From embarrassing losses to pure box office gold.

items.voiceLine: Ben Askren got knocked out in just five seconds, the fastest finish in UFC history. Undefeated hype, gone in a blink. D-Tier, an all-time embarrassing moment.
Jon Jones has this bizarre spider-crawl walk he does mid-fight, low to the ground, staring down opponents. Weird, unsettling, and somehow still effective. C-Tier, we're not sure how to feel about it.
Jorge Masvidal's flying knee that finished Askren in five seconds was so fast the cameras barely caught it. Brutal, efficient, legendary. A-Tier, no question.
And then there's Conor McGregor's billionaire strut after a knockout, suit, cigar, pure confidence oozing off him. Absolute box office. S-Tier, he knows exactly what he's doing.

outroLine: Who is the baddest fighter? Subscribe and tell me!
